# Kujdesi im

> Kujdesi im ("my care") provides medical and social care at home in Tirana, Albania: general practitioners and specialists, nurses, physiotherapists, psychologists and social workers. Every visit is documented in a medical report (vital signs, symptoms, treatment, recommendations) sent to the patient or family by email or WhatsApp. The site is in Albanian (default), English and Italian.

Contact: +355 69 000 0000, info@kujdesiim.al. Area served: Tirana. Emergencies: call 127.

## About
Doctors, nurses, physiotherapists, psychologists and social workers who care for patients in their own homes. Every visit is recorded in an online medical chart, so the patient and family always know how things stand.
- Licensed and registered: Every doctor is a member of the Order of Physicians of Albania and every nurse of the Order of Nurses. We publish licence numbers here before launch.
- The same clinical protocols for everyone: Visits, procedures and reports follow the same protocols, so quality doesn’t depend on who visits.
- A complete medical chart: Vital signs, symptoms, examination, treatment, lab tests and imaging are stored by visit date.
- Privacy by law: Medical data is handled under Albanian personal data protection law. Administrators never see personal health data.

## The online medical chart
The doctor records everything in the app during the visit. On a monthly package, you open your own chart whenever you like.
1. The doctor comes for a first visit: They get to know the patient, take the medical history and current medication, and run the checks: blood pressure, pulse, oxygen, blood sugar and temperature.
2. Everything goes into the online chart: During the visit the doctor records the vital signs, symptoms, examination, treatment and any documents you have in the app. Nothing stays only on paper.
3. Choose how to continue: Become a member with one of the monthly packages, or book services only when you need them. Every service is recorded in the chart either way.
4. Members open their own chart: On a package, you sign in to the app and see the whole history: visits, test results and their graphs, ultrasounds, X-rays and documents, sorted by date.
5. Explanations and advice from the doctor: The doctor explains your test results in plain words, notes your current health status and the recommendations going forward. You see them as soon as they are added.
Privacy: Only you and your care team: The chart is seen by the patient, the family members they choose and the professionals caring for them. No one else. Every opening is logged: Who opened or changed the chart, and when. The log can’t be deleted. Protected sign-in: Our team opens your account. A personal password, a lock after repeated wrong attempts, an encrypted connection. Documents stay private: Lab results and reports open only inside your account. You can ask for a copy, or for them to be deleted, at any time.

## Monthly home care packages
- Basic (Bazë): doctor twice a month, nurse 4 times a month, basic lab panel once, report after every visit. For people who are well but want regular check-ups.
- Medium (Medium): doctor 4 times a month, nurse twice a week, basic lab panel once, 24/7 medical phone support, report after every visit. For chronic conditions that need weekly follow-up.
- Complete (E plotë): doctor 6 times a month, nurse 10 times a month, basic lab panel every month, psychologist or physiotherapist once a month, 24/7 medical phone support, report after every visit. For bedbound patients or recovery after a hospital stay.
- Basic lab panel: full blood count, lipid profile, fasting glucose, HbA1c. Prices are quoted on request unless shown.

## Single services at home
- Procedures at home: Intramuscular or subcutaneous injection; Intravenous injection; Wound cleaning and dressing; Urinary catheter placement and change; Nasogastric tube placement; Suctioning of secretions; Ear cleaning; Blood draw for tests; IV drip (infusion); Stitch and staple removal; Stoma care; Vaccination at home
- Diagnostics: Ultrasound at home, with a report; Lab tests based on medical history; ECG at home; 24-hour Holter ECG; 24-hour blood pressure monitoring; Rapid tests at home; Blood pressure and blood sugar check
- Specialists: Physiotherapist at home; Psychologist at home; Medical specialist at home; Online consultation with an internationally experienced specialist; Paediatrician at home; Speech therapist at home; Dietitian; Occupational therapist; Palliative care at home
- Transport: Ambulance transport, priced by distance; Wheelchair transport; Escort to appointments and tests
- Support services: Personal hygiene assistant; Housekeeping help; Daytime companion; Night carer; Training for family carers

## Occupational medicine for businesses
- Basic: Doctor visit twice a month; Nurse visit twice a month; Clinical records on paper and online
- Premium: Doctor visit twice a month; Nurse visit twice a month; Clinical records on paper and online; Monthly staff training: first aid and workplace risks

## FAQ
- Which areas do you cover? We visit homes in Tirana. Ambulance transport outside the city is priced by distance. Call us and we will tell you straight away whether we cover your address.
- Who are the professionals that visit? Our team includes general practitioners and specialists, nurses, physiotherapists, psychologists and social workers. Who visits depends on the patient’s needs and the package you choose.
- What does the medical report include? Vital signs (blood pressure, pulse, oxygen saturation, blood sugar, temperature, respiratory rate), symptoms, the examination, the treatment given and recommendations. Reports are kept by date and sent to you by email or WhatsApp.
- How does the online medical chart work? On the first visit the doctor opens your chart in the app and records your vital signs, history, examination and treatment. Every visit, test, ultrasound or X-ray is added by date. On a monthly package you open the chart yourself and see your history, current status, explanations of your test results and the doctor’s recommendations.
- Who can see my medical data? Only you and the professionals caring for you, each according to their role. The service’s administrators never see personal health data.
- Can I book a single service without a package? Yes. Injections, dressings, blood draws, home ultrasound, catheter care, physiotherapy and our other services can be booked one at a time. Every service is recorded in the medical report.
- How much do the packages cost? The price depends on the address, the patient’s condition and the package. After a short call we give you an exact price, with no obligation.
- What do you offer businesses? Occupational medicine: doctor and nurse visits at your office, clinical records on paper and online at no extra cost, and on the Premium package monthly first aid training for your staff.
- What should I do in an emergency? In an emergency call 127 straight away. Clients on the Medium and Complete packages also have 24/7 medical phone support.
